text: Kiwi.com Update January 29, 2026 Prague, Czech Republic – Since our founding in 2012, Kiwi.com has sat at the forefront of product innovation, leveraging advanced technologies to deliver exceptional services and seamless end-to-end experiences for our customers worldwide. Today, we are updating our organisational structure to streamline how we operate and ensure we remain agile amidst a dynamic market backdrop to continue to provide the greatest value to our customers. As part of this process, we are rightsizing teams across several markets to create a nimbler organisation that will simplify how we work, enable faster decision-making, and further accelerate innovation. We are committed to ensuring those affected are treated fairly and receive the necessary support and resources during this time.
